manuscript: Convergence Claims for the CCM Construction: An Empirical Reassessment
status: v2.1 repository edition; Zenodo deposit maintained separately
scope: Empirical reassessment of the three original Paper 2 experiments, with independent interval checks of all seven saved kappa spectra and an analytic fixed-cutoff Mellin obstruction. No new claim campaign. Hashes bind evidence and do not replace mathematical hypotheses.
profile_scope: Least-squares replay of serialized samples from the finite-Dirichlet prolate model. No continuous-norm or regular-prolate certificate.
root_scope: Complete positive roots of exact saved secular sources. The rank-one determinant identity identifies them with the saved finite operator spectrum specified in the maximum-error definition. Analytic ground-state/source perturbation and asymptotic control remain open.
transform_scope: Observed real-part crossings fail the complex residual threshold. A separate endpoint proof establishes eventual absence of critical-line zeros for the tested fixed-cutoff naive and nonzero finite cosine-weighted transforms. No scan-completeness claim, off-line-zero exclusion, or growing-cutoff obstruction.
payload_availability: Full measurement payloads and independent audit records are retained separately and are not all bundled in the public source repository.

sweep_table_status: All seven current maximum-error rows independently checked: 1700 positive roots, pole-free sign-change brackets, degree-count completeness, and fresh error statistics. empirical_position: Evidence against uniform inverse-logarithmic maximum-error decay in the tested range: all seven maxima grow, as do maxima excluding the highest 20 percent of roots. This finite adverse trend does not settle the asymptotic limit or certify analytic source errors.
